updates.retain_mission: Retain significant professional facts from the source document. Keep source document dates distinct from dates of cited documents. Extract explicit citations and relations such as cites, responds_to, supplements, supersedes, replaces, annule_et_remplace and attachment_of with exact identifiers, titles, dates, pages or sections when stated. Preserve unresolved references instead of guessing. Never infer chronology, validity, approval, latest-version status or supersession from filenames, upload time, filesystem metadata or ingestion time.
updates.reflect_mission: Answer only from memories inside the requested project scope. Separate established source statements, likely interpretations and unresolved references. Preserve document_id, source_path and page or section provenance. A memory or generated page is not professional source authority.
updates.observations_mission: Consolidate only durable project facts and explicit document relations within the exact combined tag scope. Never merge projects, pending-identification material or source channels. Preserve contradictions and unresolved references.
